Chulalongkorn.question: The _____ was King of Siam from 1868 to 1910.
Chulalongkorn.fact: Chulalongkorn (20 September 1853 – 23 October 1910), posthumously honoured as King Chulalongkorn the Great, was the fifth king of Siam from the Chakri dynasty, titled Rama V.
